rows.label: tlk43400012_06_msg0001
rows.name:
That Bahn... I can't believe he'd
even target Queen Lagert...

rows.label: tlk43400012_06_msg0002
rows.name:
I never expected the Emperor of
Superbia to save her.

rows.label: tlk43400012_06_msg0003
rows.name:
I hear you offered us
your assistance too.

rows.label: tlk43400012_06_msg0005
rows.name:
I've been working undercover here in
Avaritia, reporting on the Nopon and
Superbia back home.

rows.label: tlk43400012_06_msg0006
rows.name:
But if that incident made Superbia
and Invidia join hands, maybe
this job won't be needed.
